127	class FleetSimulator:
128	    def __init__(self, grid: GridMap, robots: list[Robot], tasks: list[Task]) -> None:
129	        self.grid = grid
130	        # The map as built before any runtime edit; map-change history is
131	        # replayed against this baseline.
132	        self.base_grid = grid
133	        self.robots = {robot.robot_id: robot for robot in robots}
134	        self.tasks = {task.task_id: task for task in tasks}
135	        self.tick = 0
136	        self.replay: list[dict[str, object]] = []
137	        self.map_changes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
138	        self._map_sequence = 0
139	        self.paused_tasks: set[str] = set()
140	        # Consecutive per-robot waits caused purely by other robots:
141	        # robot_id -> {"blocked_by": [robot_id, ...], "ticks": int}.
142	        self._traffic_waits: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
143	        positions = [robot.position for robot in robots]
144	        if len(positions) != len(set(positions)):
145	            raise ValueError("robots cannot share an initial position")
146	        if any(not grid.traversable(position) for position in positions):
147	            raise ValueError("robot starts outside traversable map space")
148	
149	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
150	    # Dynamic map edits
151	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
152	
153	    def modify_obstacles(
154	        self,
155	        added: Sequence[Position] = (),
156	        removed: Sequence[Position] = (),
157	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
158	        """Close and/or reopen cells without advancing the simulation.
159	
160	        The whole request is validated before anything changes: coordinates
161	        must be two plain integers (booleans are rejected), lie inside the
162	        map, no cell may appear in both lists, and newly added obstacles may
163	        not cover a robot's current cell. Duplicate coordinates inside one
164	        batch are processed once. Adding an existing obstacle or removing a
165	        traversable cell is a no-op. Invalid requests raise :class:`ValueError`
166	        and leave every part of the state untouched.
167	
168	        Assigned unfinished tasks keep their robot: routes are replanned
169	        against the new map, or, when a required point is unreachable, cleared
170	        while the task is suspended. No tick is recorded, no robot moves and no
171	        distance is accumulated.
172	        """
173	        add_cells = self._normalize_cells(added, "added")
174	        remove_cells = self._normalize_cells(removed, "removed")
175	        conflict = set(add_cells) & set(remove_cells)
176	        if conflict:
177	            cell = sorted(conflict)[0]
178	            raise ValueError(
179	                f"cell {list(cell)} is both added and removed in the same request"
180	            )
181	        occupied = {robot.position for robot in self.robots.values()}
182	        for cell in add_cells:
183	            if cell in occupied:
184	                raise ValueError(
185	                    f"cannot add obstacle at {list(cell)}: a robot currently occupies it"
186	                )
187	        return self._apply_map_change(add_cells, remove_cells)
188	
189	    def _normalize_cells(self, cells: Sequence[Position], label: str) -> list[Position]:
190	        if isinstance(cells, (str, bytes)) or not isinstance(cells, (list, tuple)):
191	            raise ValueError(f"{label} cells must be provided as a list of [x, y] pairs")
192	        seen: set[Position] = set()
193	        ordered: list[Position] = []
194	        for index, cell in enumerate(cells):
195	            position = _as_cell(cell, f"{label} cell {index}")
196	            if not self.grid.contains(position):
197	                raise ValueError(f"{label} cell {list(position)} lies outside the map")
198	            if position in seen:
199	                # Batch-internal duplicates are handled once, not rejected.
200	                continue
201	            seen.add(position)
202	            ordered.append(position)
203	        return ordered
204	
205	    def _apply_map_change(
206	        self, added: list[Position], removed: list[Position]
207	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
208	        obstacles = set(self.grid.obstacles)
209	        actual_added = [cell for cell in added if cell not in obstacles]
210	        obstacles.update(actual_added)
211	        actual_removed = [cell for cell in removed if cell in obstacles]
212	        obstacles.difference_update(actual_removed)
213	        if not actual_added and not actual_removed:
214	            return self._map_change_record(self._map_sequence, [], [])
215	
216	        # Everything below only runs once the batch was fully validated and is
217	        # known to change the map.
218	        self.grid = GridMap(self.grid.width, self.grid.height, frozenset(obstacles))
219	        self._map_sequence += 1
220	        record = self._map_change_record(self._map_sequence, actual_added, actual_removed)
221	        self.map_changes.append(copy.deepcopy(record))
222	        self.replay.append(copy.deepcopy(record))
223	        self._reroute_after_map_change()
224	        return copy.deepcopy(record)
225	
226	    def _map_change_record(
227	        self, sequence: int, added: list[Position], removed: list[Position]
228	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
229	        return {
230	            "type": "map_change",
231	            "tick": self.tick,
232	            "sequence": sequence,
233	            "added": [list(cell) for cell in added],
234	            "removed": [list(cell) for cell in removed],
235	        }
236	
237	    def _plan_route(
238	        self, robot: Robot, task: Task, start: Position | None = None
239	    ) -> list[Position] | None:
240	        """Shortest current->pickup->dropoff route, or None if unreachable.
241	
242	        *start* overrides the robot's current position, which is how sidestep
243	        candidates are evaluated without moving the robot first.
244	        """
245	        origin = robot.position if start is None else start
246	        try:
247	            if not task.picked_up:
248	                if origin == task.pickup:
249	                    to_pickup: list[Position] = []
250	                else:
251	                    to_pickup = shortest_path(self.grid, origin, task.pickup)
252	                to_dropoff = shortest_path(self.grid, task.pickup, task.dropoff)
253	            else:
254	                # Goods are already on board: a reclosed pickup cell must not
255	                # pull the robot back.
256	                to_pickup = []
257	                to_dropoff = shortest_path(self.grid, origin, task.dropoff)
258	        except ValueError:
259	            return None
260	        return to_pickup + to_dropoff
261	
262	    def _reroute_after_map_change(self) -> None:
263	        for task in self.tasks.values():
264	            if task.completed or task.assigned_robot is None:
265	                continue
266	            robot = self.robots[task.assigned_robot]
267	            if robot.task_id != task.task_id:
268	                continue
269	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
270	            if route is None:
271	                robot.route = []
272	                self.paused_tasks.add(task.task_id)
273	            else:
274	                # Only the route is refreshed here; pickup/delivery are
275	                # confirmed at step start (or were already recorded).
276	                robot.route = route
277	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task.task_id)
278	
279	    def _recover_paused_tasks(self) -> None:
280	        """Resume tasks suspended by map unreachability where possible."""
281	        for task_id in sorted(self.paused_tasks):
282	            task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
283	            if task is None or task.completed or task.assigned_robot is None:
284	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
285	                continue
286	            robot = self.robots[task.assigned_robot]
287	            if robot.task_id != task.task_id:
288	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
289	                continue
290	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
291	            if route is None:
292	                robot.route = []
293	                continue
294	            robot.route = route
295	            self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
296	            self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
297	
298	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
299	    # Traffic conflicts and yielding
300	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
301	
302	    def _route_cells(self, exclude_id: str) -> set[Position]:
303	        """Cells every robot except *exclude_id* still plans to drive through."""
304	        cells: set[Position] = set()
305	        for robot in self.robots.values():
306	            if robot.robot_id != exclude_id:
307	                cells.update(robot.route)
308	        return cells
309	
310	    def _idle_sidestep_cell(
311	        self,
312	        blocker: Robot,
313	        requester: Robot,
314	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
315	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
316	    ) -> Position | None:
317	        """Free side-cell an idle blocker can yield to, or None.
318	
319	        The target may not be the requester's own cell (that would swap the
320	        two robots within one tick) nor any cell another robot still plans to
321	        drive through, so the blocker never trades one blockage for another.
322	        """
323	        on_routes = self._route_cells(exclude_id=blocker.robot_id)
324	        for cell in self.grid.neighbors(blocker.position):
325	            if cell == requester.position:
326	                continue
327	            if cell in occupied or cell in reserved:
328	                continue
329	            if cell in on_routes:
330	                continue
331	            return cell
332	        return None
333	
334	    def _self_sidestep(
335	        self,
336	        robot: Robot,
337	        task: Task | None,
338	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
339	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
340	    ) -> tuple[Position, list[Position]] | None:
341	        """Best side cell plus replanned route for a blocked robot, or None.
342	
343	        Only cells off every other robot's planned route qualify, and only if
344	        the task remains reachable from there; stepping backwards along the
345	        corridor is never useful and would just oscillate. Candidates are
346	        ranked by replanned route length with the deterministic neighbor order
347	        (up, left, right, down) breaking ties.
348	        """
349	        if task is None or task.completed:
350	            return None
351	        on_routes = self._route_cells(exclude_id=robot.robot_id)
352	        best: tuple[int, int, Position, list[Position]] | None = None
353	        for index, cell in enumerate(self.grid.neighbors(robot.position)):
354	            if cell in occupied or cell in reserved or cell in on_routes:
355	                continue
356	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task, start=cell)
357	            if route is None:
358	                continue
359	            if best is None or (len(route), index) < (best[0], best[1]):
360	                best = (len(route), index, cell, route)
361	        if best is None:
362	            return None
363	        return best[2], best[3]
364	
365	    def _update_traffic_waits(self, blocked_by: dict[str, str]) -> None:
366	        """Accumulate consecutive waits; any other outcome resets the counter."""
367	        for robot_id in list(self._traffic_waits):
368	            if robot_id not in blocked_by:
369	                del self._traffic_waits[robot_id]
370	        for robot_id, blocker_id in blocked_by.items():
371	            entry = self._traffic_waits.get(robot_id)
372	            if entry is None:
373	                self._traffic_waits[robot_id] = {"blocked_by": [blocker_id], "ticks": 1}
374	            else:
375	                entry["blocked_by"] = [blocker_id]
376	                entry["ticks"] = int(entry["ticks"]) + 1
377	
378	    def _traffic_wait_report(self) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
379	        return [
380	            {
381	                "robot_id": robot_id,
382	                "blocked_by": list(entry["blocked_by"]),
383	                "ticks": entry["ticks"],
384	            }
385	            for robot_id, entry in sorted(self._traffic_waits.items())
386	        ]
387	
388	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
389	    # Normal execution
390	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
391	
392	    def assign_tasks(self) -> None:
393	        """Assign pending tasks to the nearest idle robot using stable tie breaks."""
394	        pending = [task for task in self.tasks.values() if task.assigned_robot is None]
395	        for task in sorted(pending, key=lambda item: item.task_id):
396	            choices: list[tuple[int, str, list[tuple[int, int]]]] = []
397	            for robot in self.robots.values():
398	                if not robot.idle:
399	                    continue
400	                try:
401	                    route = shortest_path(self.grid, robot.position, task.pickup)
402	                    route += shortest_path(self.grid, task.pickup, task.dropoff)
403	                except ValueError:
404	                    continue
405	                choices.append((len(route), robot.robot_id, route))
406	            if not choices:
407	                # No robot can reach this task yet; it keeps waiting and does
408	                # not block assignment of other tasks.
409	                continue
410	            _, robot_id, route = min(choices)
411	            robot = self.robots[robot_id]
412	            robot.task_id = task.task_id
413	            robot.route = route
414	            task.assigned_robot = robot_id
415	
416	    def _confirm_pickups(self) -> None:
417	        """A robot starting a tick on its pickup point collects first."""
418	        for robot in self.robots.values():
419	            if robot.task_id is None:
420	                continue
421	            task = self.tasks[robot.task_id]
422	            if not task.completed and not task.picked_up and robot.position == task.pickup:
423	                task.picked_up = True
424	
425	    def step(self) -> dict[str, object]:
426	        self._confirm_pickups()
427	        self._recover_paused_tasks()
428	        self.assign_tasks()
429	        # A robot assigned while already standing on the pickup cell collects
430	        # immediately instead of driving off without the goods.
431	        self._confirm_pickups()
432	        occupied = {robot.position: robot.robot_id for robot in self.robots.values()}
433	        reserved: dict[tuple[int, int], str] = {}
434	        moved: list[str] = []
435	        moved_ids: set[str] = set()
436	        blocked_by: dict[str, str] = {}
437	
438	        def relocate(robot: Robot, destination: tuple[int, int]) -> None:
439	            del occupied[robot.position]
440	            robot.position = destination
441	            robot.distance_travelled += 1
442	            occupied[destination] = robot.robot_id
443	            reserved[destination] = robot.robot_id
444	            moved.append(robot.robot_id)
445	            moved_ids.add(robot.robot_id)
446	
447	        for robot in sorted(self.robots.values(), key=lambda item: item.robot_id):
448	            if robot.robot_id in moved_ids:
449	                # Already yielded this tick at another robot's request.
450	                continue
451	            task = self.tasks[robot.task_id] if robot.task_id is not None else None
452	            if task is not None and task.task_id in self.paused_tasks:
453	                # Paused by map unreachability: stays put, never yields.
454	                continue
455	            if not robot.route:
456	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
457	                continue
458	            destination = robot.route[0]
459	            if not self.grid.traversable(destination):
460	                # Defensive: routes are normally replanned on every map edit.
461	                if task is not None and not task.completed:
462	                    route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
463	                    if route is None:
464	                        robot.route = []
465	                        self.paused_tasks.add(task.task_id)
466	                    else:
467	                        robot.route = route
468	                continue
469	            blocker_id = occupied.get(destination)
470	            if blocker_id is None:
471	                blocker_id = reserved.get(destination)
472	            if blocker_id is None or blocker_id == robot.robot_id:
473	                relocate(robot, destination)
474	                robot.route.pop(0)
475	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
476	                continue
477	            # Another robot is in the way; this is distinct from a
478	            # map-unreachability pause and the task stays active.
479	            blocker = self.robots[blocker_id]
480	            if blocker_id not in moved_ids:
481	                if blocker.task_id is None:
482	                    # Idle blocker: ask it to yield onto a free side cell,
483	                    # then take over the cell it vacated.
484	                    side = self._idle_sidestep_cell(blocker, robot, occupied, reserved)
485	                    if side is not None:
486	                        relocate(blocker, side)
487	                        relocate(robot, destination)
488	                        robot.route.pop(0)
489	                        self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
490	                        continue
491	                elif blocker.route:
492	                    ahead = blocker.route[0]
493	                    if (
494	                        self.grid.traversable(ahead)
495	                        and ahead not in occupied
496	                        and ahead not in reserved
497	                    ):
498	                        # The blocker is expected to drive on within this
499	                        # tick, so waiting one tick is cheaper than detouring.
500	                        blocked_by[robot.robot_id] = blocker_id
501	                        continue
502	            # The blocker cannot or will not move this tick: try to sidestep
503	            # onto a free adjacent cell and replan from there.
504	            side = self._self_sidestep(robot, task, occupied, reserved)
505	            if side is not None:
506	                cell, route = side
507	                relocate(robot, cell)
508	                robot.route = route
509	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
510	                continue
511	            blocked_by[robot.robot_id] = blocker_id
512	        self._update_traffic_waits(blocked_by)
513	        self.tick += 1
514	        event: dict[str, object] = {
515	            "type": "tick",
516	            "tick": self.tick,
517	            "moved": moved,
518	            "robots": {robot_id: list(robot.position) for robot_id, robot in sorted(self.robots.items())},
519	            "completed": sorted(task.task_id for task in self.tasks.values() if task.completed),
520	        }
521	        self.replay.append(event)
522	        return event
523	
524	    def _finish_if_arrived(self, robot: Robot) -> None:
525	        if robot.task_id is None:
526	            return
527	        task = self.tasks[robot.task_id]
528	        if task.task_id in self.paused_tasks:
529	            return
530	        if robot.position == task.pickup:
531	            task.picked_up = True
532	        if task.picked_up and robot.position == task.dropoff and not robot.route:
533	            task.completed = True
534	            self.paused_tasks.discard(task.task_id)
535	            robot.task_id = None
536	
537	    def metrics(self) -> dict[str, object]:
538	        completed = sum(task.completed for task in self.tasks.values())
539	        return {
540	            "ticks": self.tick,
541	            "tasks_total": len(self.tasks),
542	            "tasks_completed": completed,
543	            "tasks_paused": sorted(self.paused_tasks),
544	            "completion_ratio": completed / len(self.tasks) if self.tasks else 1.0,
545	            "distance_total": sum(robot.distance_travelled for robot in self.robots.values()),
546	            "traffic_waits": self._traffic_wait_report(),
547	        }
548	
549	    def status(self) -> dict[str, object]:
550	        """Obstacles, map-unreachability pauses and per-robot traffic waits."""
551	        return {
552	            "tick": self.tick,
553	            "width": self.grid.width,
554	            "height": self.grid.height,
555	            "obstacles": [list(cell) for cell in sorted(self.grid.obstacles)],
556	            "paused_tasks": sorted(self.paused_tasks),
557	            "traffic_waits": self._traffic_wait_report(),
558	        }

560	    def map_change_history(self) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
561	        """Effective time, added/removed cells and order of every actual edit."""
562	        return copy.deepcopy(self.map_changes)

564	    def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, object]:
565	        return {
566	            "tick": self.tick,
567	            "robots": [asdict(robot) for robot in sorted(self.robots.values(), key=lambda item: item.robot_id)],
568	            "tasks": [asdict(task) for task in sorted(self.tasks.values(), key=lambda item: item.task_id)],
569	            "metrics": self.metrics(),
570	            "replay": self.replay,

577	    def save_checkpoint(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
578	        """Write the simulator state to *path* without changing this instance.
579	
580	        The write is atomic: an existing destination keeps either its complete
581	        old contents or the complete new contents, and a brand-new destination
582	        is either fully created or left absent. Filesystem or permission errors
583	        raise :class:`OSError`.
584	        """
585	        document = {
586	            "version": CHECKPOINT_VERSION,
587	            "grid": {
588	                "width": self.grid.width,
589	                "height": self.grid.height,
590	                "obstacles": [list(cell) for cell in sorted(self.grid.obstacles)],
591	            },
592	            "base_grid": {
593	                "width": self.base_grid.width,
594	                "height": self.base_grid.height,
595	                "obstacles": [list(cell) for cell in sorted(self.base_grid.obstacles)],
596	            },
597	            "tick": self.tick,
598	            "robots": [
599	                {
600	                    "robot_id": robot.robot_id,
601	                    "position": list(robot.position),
602	                    "route": [list(cell) for cell in robot.route],
603	                    "task_id": robot.task_id,
604	                    "distance_travelled": robot.distance_travelled,
605	                }
606	                for robot in sorted(self.robots.values(), key=lambda item: item.robot_id)
607	            ],
608	            "tasks": [
609	                {
610	                    "task_id": task.task_id,
611	                    "pickup": list(task.pickup),
612	                    "dropoff": list(task.dropoff),
613	                    "assigned_robot": task.assigned_robot,
614	                    "picked_up": task.picked_up,
615	                    "completed": task.completed,
616	                }
617	                for task in sorted(self.tasks.values(), key=lambda item: item.task_id)
618	            ],
619	            "replay": copy.deepcopy(self.replay),
620	            "map_changes": copy.deepcopy(self.map_changes),
621	            "paused_tasks": sorted(self.paused_tasks),
622	            "traffic_waits": self._traffic_wait_report(),
623	        }
624	        payload = (json.dumps(document, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
625	
626	        directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(os.fspath(path))) or os.curdir
627	        fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".checkpoint-", suffix=".tmp", dir=directory)
628	        try:
629	            handle = os.fdopen(fd, "wb")
630	            try:
631	                handle.write(payload)
632	                handle.flush()
633	                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
634	            finally:
635	                handle.close()
636	            os.replace(tmp_name, path)
637	            self._fsync_directory(directory)
638	        except BaseException:
639	            # After a successful replace the temp name is already gone.
640	            try:
641	                os.unlink(tmp_name)
642	            except OSError:
643	                pass
644	            raise
645	
646	    @staticmethod
647	    def _fsync_directory(directory: str) -> None:
648	        try:
649	            dir_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
650	        except OSError:
651	            return
652	        try:
653	            os.fsync(dir_fd)
654	        except OSError:
655	            pass
656	        finally:
657	            os.close(dir_fd)

659	    @classmethod
660	    def load_checkpoint(cls, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> FleetSimulator:
661	        """Load an independent simulator instance from *path*.
662	
663	        The returned simulator shares no mutable state with the file or any
664	        other loaded instance. Invalid checkpoint content raises
665	        :class:`ValueError` explaining the reason; read/permission failures
666	        propagate as :class:`OSError`.
667	        """
668	        try:
669	            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
670	                text = handle.read()
671	        except OSError:
672	            raise
673	        try:
674	            data = json.loads(text)
675	        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
676	            raise ValueError(f"checkpoint is not valid JSON: {exc.msg}") from exc
677	        return cls._from_checkpoint(data)
678	
679	    @classmethod
680	    def _from_checkpoint(cls, data: object) -> FleetSimulator:
681	        if not isinstance(data, dict):
682	            raise ValueError("checkpoint root must be a JSON object")
683	
684	        version = data.get("version")
685	        if not _is_int(version):
686	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'version' must be an integer")
687	        if version not in _SUPPORTED_VERSIONS:
688	            raise ValueError(
689	                f"unsupported checkpoint version {version}; supported versions: "
690	                f"{sorted(_SUPPORTED_VERSIONS)}"
691	            )
692	
693	        grid = cls._load_grid(data)
694	        tick = cls._load_tick(data)
695	        robot_records, task_records = cls._load_entities(data)
696	
697	        map_changes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
698	        paused: set[str] = set()
699	        if version == 1:
700	            replay = cls._load_legacy_replay(data)
701	            base_grid = grid
702	        else:
703	            replay = cls._load_replay(data)
704	            map_changes = cls._load_map_changes(data)
705	            paused = cls._load_paused_tasks(data)
706	            base_grid = cls._load_base_grid(data)
707	            if (base_grid.width, base_grid.height) != (grid.width, grid.height):
708	                raise ValueError("base grid dimensions must match the current grid")
709	            cls._validate_map_history(base_grid, grid, map_changes)
710	
711	        robots: list[Robot] = []
712	        for record in robot_records:
713	            position = _as_pair(record["position"], f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} position")
714	            if not grid.traversable(position):
715	                raise ValueError(
716	                    f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} position {list(position)} is outside "
717	                    "the map or inside an obstacle"
718	                )
719	            route: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
720	            previous = position
721	            for index, cell in enumerate(record["route"]):
722	                waypoint = _as_pair(
723	                    cell, f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route entry {index}"
724	                )
725	                if not grid.traversable(waypoint):
726	                    raise ValueError(
727	                        f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route entry {list(waypoint)} is "
728	                        "outside the map or inside an obstacle"
729	                    )
730	                if abs(waypoint[0] - previous[0]) + abs(waypoint[1] - previous[1]) != 1:
731	                    raise ValueError(
732	                        f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route moves non-adjacently from "
733	                        f"{list(previous)} to {list(waypoint)}"
734	                    )
735	                route.append(waypoint)
736	                previous = waypoint
737	            distance = record["distance_travelled"]
738	            if not _is_int(distance) or distance < 0:
739	                raise ValueError(
740	                    f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} distance_travelled must be a "
741	                    "non-negative integer"
742	                )
743	            robots.append(Robot(record["robot_id"], position, route, record["task_id"], distance))
744	
745	        tasks: list[Task] = []
746	        for record in task_records:
747	            pickup = _as_pair(record["pickup"], f"task {record['task_id']!r} pickup")
748	            dropoff = _as_pair(record["dropoff"], f"task {record['task_id']!r} dropoff")
749	            tasks.append(
750	                Task(
751	                    record["task_id"],
752	                    pickup,
753	                    dropoff,
754	                    record["assigned_robot"],
755	                    record["picked_up"],
756	                    record["completed"],
757	                )
758	            )
759	
760	        robot_by_id = {robot.robot_id: robot for robot in robots}
761	        task_by_id = {task.task_id: task for task in tasks}
762	
763	        for robot in robots:
764	            if robot.task_id is not None:
765	                task = task_by_id.get(robot.task_id)
766	                if task is None:
767	                    raise ValueError(
768	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes unknown task {robot.task_id!r}"
769	                    )
770	                if task.completed:
771	                    raise ValueError(
772	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes task {task.task_id!r} that is "
773	                        "already completed"
774	                    )
775	                if task.assigned_robot != robot.robot_id:
776	                    raise ValueError(
777	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes task {task.task_id!r} but the "
778	                        f"task is assigned to {task.assigned_robot!r}"
779	                    )
780	        for task in tasks:
781	            if task.completed and not task.picked_up:
782	                raise ValueError(f"task {task.task_id!r} is completed but never picked up")
783	            if task.picked_up and task.assigned_robot is None:
784	                raise ValueError(
785	                    f"task {task.task_id!r} is picked up but has no assigned robot"
786	                )
787	            # Completed tasks retain historical ownership; their robots are free
788	            # to take new work, so the mutual binding only holds while a task is
789	            # still in progress.
790	            if not task.completed and task.assigned_robot is not None:
791	                owner = robot_by_id.get(task.assigned_robot)
792	                if owner is None:
793	                    raise ValueError(
794	                        f"task {task.task_id!r} is assigned to unknown robot "
795	                        f"{task.assigned_robot!r}"
796	                    )
797	                if owner.task_id != task.task_id:
798	                    raise ValueError(
799	                        f"task {task.task_id!r} claims robot {owner.robot_id!r} but the "
800	                        f"robot executes {owner.task_id!r}"
801	                    )
802	
803	        cls._validate_paused_state(paused, task_by_id, robot_by_id, grid)
804	        traffic_waits = cls._load_traffic_waits(data, robot_by_id)
805	
806	        replay_change_frames = cls._replay_map_change_frames(replay)
807	        if replay_change_frames != map_changes:
808	            raise ValueError("replay map-change frames do not match 'map_changes' history")
809	
810	        simulator = cls(grid, robots, tasks)
811	        simulator.base_grid = base_grid
812	        simulator.tick = tick
813	        simulator.replay = copy.deepcopy(replay)
814	        simulator.map_changes = copy.deepcopy(map_changes)
815	        simulator._map_sequence = len(map_changes)
816	        simulator.paused_tasks = set(paused)
817	        simulator._traffic_waits = traffic_waits
818	        cls._validate_replay_positions(replay, tick, robot_by_id)
819	        return simulator
820	
821	    @staticmethod
822	    def _require_field(data: Mapping[str, object], field_name: str) -> object:
823	        if field_name not in data:
824	            raise ValueError(f"checkpoint is missing required field {field_name!r}")
825	        return data[field_name]

827	    @classmethod
828	    def _load_grid(cls, data: Mapping[str, object]) -> GridMap:
829	        raw = cls._require_field(data, "grid")
830	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
831	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'grid' must be an object")
832	        width = raw.get("width")
833	        height = raw.get("height")
834	        if not _is_int(width) or width <= 0:
835	            raise ValueError("checkpoint grid width must be a positive integer")
836	        if not _is_int(height) or height <= 0:
837	            raise ValueError("checkpoint grid height must be a positive integer")
838	        raw_obstacles = raw.get("obstacles")
839	        if not isinstance(raw_obstacles, list):
840	            raise ValueError("checkpoint grid 'obstacles' must be a list")
841	        obstacles: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
842	        for index, cell in enumerate(raw_obstacles):
843	            obstacle = _as_pair(cell, f"obstacle entry {index}")
844	            if not (0 <= obstacle[0] < width and 0 <= obstacle[1] < height):
845	                raise ValueError(f"obstacle {list(obstacle)} lies outside the map")
846	            obstacles.add(obstacle)
847	        try:
848	            return GridMap(width, height, frozenset(obstacles))
849	        except ValueError as exc:
850	            raise ValueError(f"invalid checkpoint grid: {exc}") from exc

852	    @classmethod

854	        raw = cls._require_field(data, "base_grid")
855	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
856	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'base_grid' must be an object")
857	        width = raw.get("width")
858	        height = raw.get("height")
859	        if not _is_int(width) or width <= 0:
860	            raise ValueError("checkpoint base grid width must be a positive integer")
861	        if not _is_int(height) or height <= 0:
862	            raise ValueError("checkpoint base grid height must be a positive integer")
863	        raw_obstacles = raw.get("obstacles")
864	        if not isinstance(raw_obstacles, list):
865	            raise ValueError("checkpoint base grid 'obstacles' must be a list")
866	        obstacles: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
867	        for index, cell in enumerate(raw_obstacles):
868	            obstacle = _as_pair(cell, f"base obstacle entry {index}")
869	            if not (0 <= obstacle[0] < width and 0 <= obstacle[1] < height):
870	                raise ValueError(f"base obstacle {list(obstacle)} lies outside the map")
871	            obstacles.add(obstacle)
872	        try:
873	            return GridMap(width, height, frozenset(obstacles))
874	        except ValueError as exc:

877	    @classmethod
878	    def _load_tick(cls, data: Mapping[str, object]) -> int:
879	        tick = cls._require_field(data, "tick")

881	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'tick' must be a non-negative integer")

884	    @classmethod
885	    def _load_entities(
886	        cls, data: Mapping[str, object]
887	    ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, object]], list[dict[str, object]]]:
888	        raw_robots = cls._require_field(data, "robots")
889	        raw_tasks = cls._require_field(data, "tasks")
890	        if not isinstance(raw_robots, list):
891	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'robots' must be a list")
892	        if not isinstance(raw_tasks, list):
893	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'tasks' must be a list")
894	
895	        robot_records: list[dict[str, object]] = []
896	        robot_ids: set[str] = set()
897	        for index, record in enumerate(raw_robots):
898	            if not isinstance(record, dict):
899	                raise ValueError(f"robot entry {index} must be an object")
900	            robot_id = record.get("robot_id")
901	            if not isinstance(robot_id, str):
902	                raise ValueError(f"robot entry {index} field 'robot_id' must be a string")
903	            if robot_id in robot_ids:
904	                raise ValueError(f"duplicate robot id {robot_id!r} in checkpoint")
905	            robot_ids.add(robot_id)
906	            task_id = record.get("task_id")
907	            if task_id is not None and not isinstance(task_id, str):
908	                raise ValueError(f"robot {robot_id!r} field 'task_id' must be a string or null")
909	            if "position" not in record:
910	                raise ValueError(f"robot {robot_id!r} is missing field 'position'")
911	            route = record.get("route")
912	            if not isinstance(route, list):
913	                raise ValueError(f"robot {robot_id!r} field 'route' must be a list")
914	            if "distance_travelled" not in record:
915	                raise ValueError(f"robot {robot_id!r} is missing field 'distance_travelled'")
916	            robot_records.append(record)
917	
918	        task_records: list[dict[str, object]] = []
919	        task_ids: set[str] = set()
920	        for index, record in enumerate(raw_tasks):
921	            if not isinstance(record, dict):
922	                raise ValueError(f"task entry {index} must be an object")
923	            task_id = record.get("task_id")
924	            if not isinstance(task_id, str):
925	                raise ValueError(f"task entry {index} field 'task_id' must be a string")
926	            if task_id in task_ids:
927	                raise ValueError(f"duplicate task id {task_id!r} in checkpoint")
928	            task_ids.add(task_id)
929	            assigned = record.get("assigned_robot")
930	            if assigned is not None and not isinstance(assigned, str):
931	                raise ValueError(
932	                    f"task {task_id!r} field 'assigned_robot' must be a string or null"
933	                )
934	            if not isinstance(record.get("picked_up"), bool):
935	                raise ValueError(f"task {task_id!r} field 'picked_up' must be a boolean")
936	            if not isinstance(record.get("completed"), bool):
937	                raise ValueError(f"task {task_id!r} field 'completed' must be a boolean")
938	            if "pickup" not in record:
939	                raise ValueError(f"task {task_id!r} is missing field 'pickup'")
940	            if "dropoff" not in record:
941	                raise ValueError(f"task {task_id!r} is missing field 'dropoff'")
942	            task_records.append(record)
943	
944	        positions = [
945	            tuple(record["position"])
946	            for record in robot_records
947	            if isinstance(record["position"], list)
948	            and len(record["position"]) == 2
949	            and all(_is_int(value) for value in record["position"])
950	        ]
951	        if len(positions) != len(set(positions)):
952	            raise ValueError("checkpoint robots cannot share a position")
953	        return robot_records, task_records
